prompt: Eight quiz scores are $6, 7, 7, 8, 8, 8, 9, 10$. If you draw a dotplot, how many dots are stacked above the number $8$?
hint: A dotplot puts ONE dot per data value, stacked above that number on the line.

hints.text: A dotplot puts ONE dot per data value, stacked above that number on the line.
Count how many times $8$ appears in the list.
$8$ appears three times, so there are $3$ dots above $8$.

explanation: Each score becomes one dot above its value.
The score $8$ shows up three times in the list.
So the tallest stack, above $8$, has $3$ dots. That value is the mode.

alternativeExplanations.title: Build the whole plot
steps: Above 6: 1 dot. Above 7: 2 dots. Above 8: 3 dots.
Above 9: 1 dot. Above 10: 1 dot. Total $1 + 2 + 3 + 1 + 1 = 8$ dots, matching the 8 scores.
The stack above 8 is the tallest, with 3 dots.
